name: map_columns
description: Map Excel column headers to standard RFQ format columns

column_mapping.description: Mapping of Excel header names to target RFQ column names. Key = Excel header, Value = Target column (S.No, ItemDescription, Specification, Uom, Quantity, Remarks)

confidence.description: Overall confidence percentage (0-100) in the column mapping

unmapped_headers.description: List of Excel headers that could not be mapped to any target column

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of the mapping decisions made

mapping_details.description: Detailed information about each mapping decision
